name: @gjsify/react-native
description: The React Native view vocabulary rendered onto GTK4/Adwaita, over @gjsify/gtk-host

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tmp tsconfig.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --outfile test.gjs.mjs --define "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'" --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.build:test:node: gjsify build src/test.mts --app node --outfile dist/test.node.mjs --define "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'" --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:gjs
scripts.test:gjs-on-node: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test:node && node dist/test.node.mjs

osNotes.darwin: Platform.OS reads the host OS, so this package owes an OS claim (ADR 0018). MEASURED 2026-08-31 by gtk-os-suites.yml on darwin-arm64 (macOS 26.5.2) and darwin-x64 (macOS 15.7.9), on Node against the published @gjsify/gtk-runtime-darwin-* closure with no Homebrew GTK on the host — the combination ADR 0024 § 4 puts a shipped .app on. The layer this package renders through, @gjsify/gtk-host, is GATING and green there: 2274 of 2274 on both arches. Its OWN suite ran as a probe and reported 2 of 857 on each arch — BY NAME the same two that fail on Linux under the node target (#1438), so darwin adds nothing to that set. Not `supported` because those two are red on every OS on this runtime, not because anything here is darwin-specific: the widgets are GTK4/Adwaita and the style partition is pure TS. Promote when #1438 closes and that step becomes a gate.
osNotes.win32: As darwin for why a claim is owed, and one step further: there is no GJS host on Windows at all (ADR 0024 § 4), so the only route is Node + @gjsify/node-gi + @gjsify/gtk-runtime-win32-x64 — which gtk-os-suites.yml installs from npm and MEASURED on 2026-08-31. The closure is sound and GATING: the published bundle verifies (33 backed typelibs, windowing=true, decode probe) and check-batteries.mjs loads Gtk + Adw with no gvsbuild GTK on the host. The suite reported 7 of 848 — and that NUMBER is the misleading part, so here is its attribution: 2 are the #1438 baseline that is red on every OS, 1 is a knock-on of one of them (the same `popped` seam), 2 are inherited from @gjsify/gtk-host's table declaring GTK's Unix print stack (#1446, and gtk-host itself is 6 of 2264 there against 2274/2274 on both darwin arches), and 2 are POSIX-shaped ASSERTIONS rather than defects: the Image/ImageBackground vectors round-trip '/nonexistent-gjsify-vector.png' through Gio.File.new_for_path (src/components.ts) and assert get_path() returns it unchanged, but get_path() answers the NATIVE path, so GLib correctly returns '\\nonexistent-gjsify-vector.png'. The URI reading is excluded by the code: the assertion calls get_path(), not get_uri(). So this layer's own win32-specific defect count is ZERO, and `partial` records unmeasured ground rather than a Windows wall. Only win32-x64 is measurable at all — gvsbuild publishes no arm64 GTK. Promote when #1438 and #1446 close and the two assertions stop being POSIX-shaped.
